posts.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): Cognition raises late-stage capital at $48B — valuation multiple higher than Cursor’s pre-SpaceX sale; investors bet AI coding stays multi-player.

posts.title: AI coding startup Cognition raises $2B at $48B valuation as revenue nears $900M
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 8): Series E >$2B nearly doubles May valuation; run-rate revenue said to approach ~$900M — Devin/Windsurf coding-agent scale story.

posts.title: Cognition AI raises $2 billion at $48 billion valuation
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 8): Series E led by a16z and Accel with Founders Fund, GC, Avenir; revenue run-rate cited from $492M to nearly $900M since May’s $26B round.

posts.title: Cognition Raised Over $2 Billion at a $48 Billion Valuation
posts.summary: Prismix/The Information (Sep 8): Coding-agent startup Devin nearly doubles May valuation — cluster confirmation that AI coding remains a funding magnet (Signal→Prismix).

posts.title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): Anthropic warns after users saw token burn while idle — account-token theft targeting Claude subscribers.

posts.title: OpenAI fought dirty on career-making math problem, says NYU mathematician
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): Tristan Buckmaster alleges pressure over Navier–Stokes AI-assisted work and Anthropic co-author credit after Codex drafts; OpenAI disputes.

posts.title: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): Buckmaster says OpenAI then claimed a breakthrough on a related Navier–Stokes path; company denies seeing unpublished work.

posts.title: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 8): OpenAI says ~10k agents + stronger-than-Astra internal model produced a Lean-checked Navier–Stokes blowup proof — contested by prior Buckmaster/Alpöge work.

posts.title: Navier–Stokes — OpenAI agents produce a Lean-checked blowup proof
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 8): Release brief — internal model + ~10,000 agents; paper plus Lean formalization on GitHub claimed for finite-time 3D blowup.

posts.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): Muse personal agent connects email, calendars, payments via per-user Secure VMs — major trust test; free tier plus paid plans.

posts.title: Meta bets on AI agent Muse to catch up in AI race
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 8): Muse pitched for ease of use and privacy options after Meta’s multi-billion AI overhaul — consumer agent framed as catch-up vs OpenAI/Anthropic/Google.

posts.title: Muse — Meta's personal AI agent runs in its own secure virtual machine
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 8): Muse Spark-powered personal agent; per-person Secure VM + Sentinel approval gate; US launch via muse.ai, apps, WhatsApp.

posts.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 — OpenAI's image model adds Sketch and two API tiers
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 8): Images 2.5 adds Sketch doodle prompts, sharper likeness, up to ~50% lower latency; API tiers Flare and Sunburst.

posts.title: Qualcomm inks AI chip, optical networking deal with Amazon
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 8): Qualcomm to supply Amazon AI chips + optical networking; stock warrant lets Amazon buy up to ~$4B of QCOM shares.

posts.title: Qualcomm, Amazon strike $4 billion custom chip deal
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 8): Warrant ~$4B at $161.26/share tied to up to $60B product purchases; custom AI inference chips plus optical links to 1.6 Tb/s.

posts.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): French lab Series D at €21B valuation led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe, PSG Equity — Europe’s largest private tech equity round claim.

posts.title: Mistral AI raises 3 billion euros in Europe's largest-ever tech funding round despite lagging behind rivals
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): €3B Series D pushes valuation past €21B three years after launch — sovereign-AI capital story.

posts.title: Meta drops AI usage from engineer performance reviews after "tokenmaxxing" backfires
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): Meta stops judging engineers by AI-tool usage metrics after tokenmaxxing distorted reviews.

posts.title: Making open-source AI weather forecasting models easy to run
posts.summary: Hugging Face Blog (Sep 8): Hugging Face + Earthmover tutorial/demo to run open weather models (Aurora et al.) with analysis-ready initial conditions.

posts.title: Meta says Muse Spark 1.3 has frontier performance — but its best results come from a model developers can’t broadly use yet
posts.summary: VentureBeat (Sep 3; freshest non-sponsored VB AI piece this cycle): Muse Spark 1.3 xhigh ships; max config still gated — AA Index ~61 vs Anthropic lead.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals estimated at $517B+
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @validapau): The Information's Valida Pau estimates Anthropic has locked ~$517B+ in compute deals and large GW capacity since Oct 25, framed as IPO-investor focus. Treat as rumor/analysis, not an official Anthropic figure.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @amir): Amir Efrati (The Information) says Nvidia is in talks to put $2.5B–$3B into Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab (~$40B round context). Treat as rumor — talks, not a closed round.

rumors.title: SoftBank talks to buy majority of OpenAI-backed 1X at ~$6B
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @validapau): SoftBank in talks for a majority stake in humanoid robot maker 1X at about $6B; prior OpenAI acquisition talks mentioned. Not confirmed by SoftBank/1X.
